# OpenAI math formalization (Steinitz–Bergström): attribution

The proof lesson explains one lemma, `OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.signedOrder_prefix_bound`, from OpenAI's
released Lean formalization of *The Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström theorem*:
<https://github.com/openai/math> at commit `4eaee87548250b2682affda7d05d947c05554bae`.

That repository is licensed under the Apache License 2.0; its licence text is in [LICENSE](LICENSE) (copied
unchanged from the pinned upstream copy). This project copies no upstream code. The lesson's short statements
paraphrase the pinned declarations (`src/lessons/steinitz/source.ts`). The proof belongs to its authors.
